name: DAAD P.R.I.M.E. - Postdoctoral Researchers International Mobility Experience
amount: Salary at TV-L E13 postdoc rate + expatriate allowance + lump-sum travel allowance (incl. family)
other_rules: at least 3 years of research in Germany within the 5 years before the deadline (PhD time counts)
doctorate no more than 6 years old (exceptions for parental or care leave)
no more than 12 months in the destination country in the 3 years before the deadline
non-EU applicants must spend the abroad phase within the EU
notes: Employed by a German university: 12 months abroad then 6 months back in Germany. Portal opens January 2027, closes April 2027 (exact date not confirmed); earliest start 1 Apr 2028. Needs approval from the German university's leadership.
